items.question: Explain the prototype chain in JavaScript.
items.answer: Every object has [[Prototype]] via Object.getPrototypeOf. Property reads check own properties first, then walk the chain until null. new links instances to Constructor.prototype. class extends wires the same links. Method calls are prototype lookups — not C# virtual tables.
followUps: What if you replace Constructor.prototype after creating instances?
items.sixtySeconds: Lookup walks own props then [[Prototype]] chain. new links instance to Constructor.prototype. class is sugar. instanceof checks linkage.

items.question: Is JavaScript class syntax different from prototypes?
items.answer: class desugars to constructor + prototype. extends sets prototype [[Prototype]] links. Methods on ClassName.prototype. typeof MyClass is function. Derived constructors must call super() before this. Class field arrows create per-instance functions with lexical this.
followUps: Can a constructor return a different object?
items.sixtySeconds: class is sugar over prototypes. super before this in derived ctor. Static methods on the constructor function.

items.question: Walk through the this binding rules.
items.answer: this is set at call time: default (strict undefined), implicit (obj.method), explicit (call/apply/bind), new (fresh object), arrow (lexical). Priority: new beats bind beats implicit beats default. Detaching obj.method loses implicit binding.
followUps: Predict this in setTimeout callback in a method.
How do arrow class fields fix lost this?
items.sixtySeconds: Five rules at call site. Arrows capture lexical this. const f = obj.m; f() loses binding. Fix with bind, arrow field, or wrapper.

items.question: How do # private fields differ from TypeScript private and C# private?
items.answer: JS #fields are runtime slots accessible only inside the class body. TS private erases to public properties unless you use #. C# private is CLR-enforced with full access modifier model. Underscore prefix is convention only.
followUps: Can a subclass access parent # field?
items.sixtySeconds: Three privates: # runtime, TS compile-only, C# CLR. Symbols obscure keys but are not secret.

items.question: Inheritance versus composition in JavaScript?
items.answer: Default to composition: pass store, clock, clients into factories. Use extends for small polymorphic surfaces. Mixins copy onto prototypes — watch collisions. Deep BaseWorker hierarchies are fragile like in C#.
followUps: What breaks when base constructor calls override?
items.sixtySeconds: Compose deps for services. extends for shallow is-a polymorphism. Same BaseService smell as C#.

items.question: What are property descriptors?
items.answer: Each property has writable, enumerable, configurable flags. Literals default all true. defineProperty can lock assignment or hide from Object.keys. for...in walks enumerable prototype keys — use Object.hasOwn for own keys. Object.freeze is shallow.
items.sixtySeconds: Descriptors control write, enumerate, reconfigure. freeze is shallow. hasOwn filters prototype keys in loops.

items.question: How is JavaScript OOP different from C# and TypeScript?
items.answer: JS runtime has objects and prototype lookup — no nominal types, no runtime interfaces, reference equality. TS adds structural checks that erase. C# preserves CLR metadata: nominal typing, is/as, virtual/override, Equals/GetHashCode, runtime private. instanceof works for JS classes; TS interfaces throw ReferenceError.
followUps: Structural typing example TS allows that C# rejects.
Is JS dispatch like C# virtual?
items.sixtySeconds: JS: objects + prototypes. TS: erased structural types. C#: CLR metadata. That split explains privacy, interfaces, equality, dispatch.

items.question: Prototype dispatch versus C# virtual dispatch?
items.answer: C# virtual/override uses fixed vtable slots from metadata. JS finds methods by walking the prototype chain; Constructor.prototype can be mutated at runtime. class does not add virtual tables — same prototype mechanism.
items.sixtySeconds: C# vtable fixed in metadata. JS prototype lookup mutable. class is sugar only.
